says: In next/, a hands command whose child prints less than the cap and never closes its output never answers: capped.ts waits on stdout and stderr with no time limit, so the job stays executing for good.
proof: A scratch vitest case (outside the worktree) ran CommandsNode.layer over Spawner.test-support.ts's fake with one 19-byte stdout chunk and endless: true, wrapped in Effect.timeoutOption("3 seconds"): it printed ANSWER {"_id":"Option","_tag":"None"} closes=1 spawns=1, so execute gave no answer and the child's scope closed only because the timeout interrupted it.
cost: A git wrapper or a grandchild that holds the pipe open leaves the hands stuck in executing with no result and no report; Result has no reason for it, so the fix needs a deadline and a reason chosen in a plan.
